title: Remove Nth Node From End
description: Remove the nth node from the end of a singly linked list in one pass.

data.text: Given `head`, remove the nth node from the end of the list and return the new head.

data.title: Count Then Remove O(2n) O(1)
Fast-Pointer Lead O(n) O(1)
What improved
data.text: Counting the list first requires a full walk before removal can begin. By advancing the fast pointer n steps ahead and then moving both pointers together, the slow pointer lands exactly one node before the target. The list is traversed only once.

cards.title: One-Pass Two-Pointer
cards.description: Fast pointer creates a gap, slow follows
